title: Ability order 1133 (ball T1 at 200) vs 1331 (Power Surge T1 at 500) in the first 1.6k souls
question: Under the game-data unlock model, does putting the first ability point into Lightning Ball (2nd charge at 200 souls) beat Power Surge T1 (cd 50->32 s at 500 souls) for lane damage and wave clear from 200 to 900 souls?
hypothesis: H-N0: at 500 souls (ball T1 + Power Surge unlocked T0 vs ball U + Power Surge T1), total damage to a lane wave + one enemy hero over 60 s is >= 10% higher with ball first; prediction from data: 2 ball casts per 26 s vs 1, Power Surge one extra window per ~110 s.

setup.position: mid lane, trooper wave + 1 enemy hero bot at 15 m

controls: Arms interleaved A,B,A,B; A/A floor run first
Same souls/level per arm; ability tiers set with abil ops per FOUNDATIONS F9 (unlocked 1, T1 3, T2 7, T3 15), logged before each block
Same bot heroes, positions, HP keep-alive and resists
Unlock model: only valid if the sandbox shows 'unlocked' and 'T1' as different states (F5/F9)
procedure: set souls 500 and abil per arm; log tiers
60 s: cast 1 on cooldown/charges, cast 3 on cooldown, fire continuously at the hero

metrics.name: total_damage_60s
metrics.how: damage csv, all sources, hero + troopers

decision.rule: ORDER_1133 >= +10% supports; reverse refutes; else inconclusive -> keep 1133 (Kieran's stated rule)

blockedIfNo: abil op logging (FOUNDATIONS F11: never run with logging)
